config.title: Out of combat speed
config.about: In a run, move faster when you have not hit an enemy for a while; hitting one ends it.

settings.title: Speed
settings.about: Movement speed while out of combat, times your usual speed. The game's own top speed still applies.

settings.title: Time without a hit
settings.about: Seconds since you last hit an enemy before the boost starts.

settings.title: In town too
settings.about: Also boost in town, where there is nothing to hit.
